authorship: Expected values written by hand by Claude (architect), checked independently, committed by Avi. Codex must never edit this file. If a case fails and you believe the expected value is wrong, stop and report the case ID and your reasoning.
comparison_rules: Numbers compare within tolerance_abs, except ten_thousand_at_trough and ten_thousand_lost, which compare within tolerance_abs_pounds (they are about 10,000 times larger, so ordinary floating-point error is larger too). Months (strings), booleans, integers (month counts) and null compare exactly. A null expected value means the result must be None. The result of largest_fall must have exactly the keys listed in the interface, no more and no fewer.

interface.errors: Uses SeriesError and CoverageError from engine.series.
interface.volatility(series): Sample standard deviation (n - 1) of the monthly returns, times sqrt(12). Float.
interface.largest_fall(series): Returns a dict with exactly these keys: max_drawdown (float, zero or negative), peak_month, trough_month, recovery_month ("YYYY-MM" or None), recovered (bool, or None when there was no fall), months_peak_to_trough, months_trough_to_recovery, months_underwater (int or None), ten_thousand_at_trough, ten_thousand_lost (floats, both zero or positive), drawdown_at_end (float, zero or negative).

cases.derivation: Returns +1%, -1%, +1%, -1% (101/100, 99.99/101, 100.9899/99.99, 99.980001/100.9899). Mean 0. Squared deviations 4 x 0.0001 = 0.0004. Sample variance divides by n - 1 = 3: 0.0004/3. Times 12: 0.0016. Square root: 0.04 = 4.0%. Dividing by n = 4 instead would give sqrt(0.0012) = 3.46%, so this case catches the wrong standard deviation.
Same series in pence: returns are ratios, so identical to R01.
Returns +10%, -10%. Mean 0. Squared deviations 0.01 + 0.01 = 0.02, divided by n - 1 = 1: 0.02. Times 12: 0.24. Square root of 0.24 = 0.489897948..., about 49.0%.
Every return is +1%, so there is no variation: volatility 0. Volatility measures bumpiness, not direction.
Two values give one return. A sample standard deviation needs at least two.
An exchange-rate series is not an investment. Rejected.
